title: Regrade accepted results from later signals and correct dependent experience
goal: Let later checks, reverts and user feedback revise confidence in exact artifacts and retire knowledge whose supporting basis has been refuted.
scope: Implement ConsequenceSource LaterChecks, VcsReverts and UserFeedback with explicit source/subject digest/evidence/time and durable polling progress. Cover LaterCheckPass/LaterCheckFail/Revert/Reopen/UserAccepted/UserRejected without changing their attribution or turning a generic project event into evidence about every result.

Ingest each external signal once; regrade acceptances whose artifact digest equals subject. LaterCheckFail/Revert/UserRejected produce Refuted; LaterCheckPass/UserAccepted count toward n_corroborate and Confirmed(Consequences) only with no negative signals.

Give Reopen an explicit non-confirming/non-refuting handling consistent with its supporting evidence: record and surface the signal for renewed investigation; do not equate the name alone with failure because A7 does not assign it a grade transition.

Feed regraded consequences into CreditPolicy/ExperienceVault, revisit dependent Knowledge and retire when a falsifier/refuted consequence applies. Integrate consequence wakeups and resumable post-delivery processing into the Dispatcher built by W1/W3; preserve original acceptances/results and an attributable later Regraded history.
acceptance: A real local later check, a fixture repository revert and explicit user feedback are ingested through their actual source consumers; only matching artifact acceptances regrade. Duplicate polls and unrelated digests have no duplicate effect.

Positive corroboration reaches Confirmed(Consequences) at the configured threshold, a negative signal refutes, and Reopen alone does not invent a fail/pass. Dependent knowledge is reviewed/retired while prior content and retrieval versions remain traceable.

The W5 executable scenario delivers first, learns and trials knowledge in later sessions, then ingests a negative consequence and exposes regrading/retirement with reconciled learning costs. Source replacement uses materially different implementations and records them.
context: Authority: ymp-docs/self-organizing-team-domain-model.md, sections 3.6 (Consequence), 4 (AcceptanceAuthority.regrade, ExperienceVault.observe), 5.6 (ConsequenceSource), A7/A12 and R-11/R-16/R-18. Use the approved model with 811a872 semantics and the greenfield baseline in 0c61ff1 and §5.8 for experimental strategy boundaries. Other documents and existing names explain implementation facts only.

Greenfield: create this behavior in the new implementation. Paths below are PROPOSED target modules under the layout owned by W1-0001; only completed prerequisite tasks supply implementation. Prior source, APIs, fixtures and delivery claims are not a baseline.

Create proposed runtime/consequences.rs with concrete LaterChecks/VcsReverts/UserFeedback adapters and kernel regrading/experience integration. W5 predecessors provide qualified observations, knowledge lineage and exact retrieval versions. Polling is explicit and does not authorize reverting user code or sending messages.

Apply source signals only to exact artifact digests. Reopen alone has no prescribed A7 grade transition: record it for investigation without manufacturing success/failure. Attribute initial acceptance/later consequences and deduplicate repeated ingestion of the same source.

Regraded is new history, not a rewrite of results or delivered report. Non-model ingestion does not authorize further model investigation/curation after stop; such work needs continuation authority and unprotected budget. Complete the wave scenario with post-delivery learning/trials and later correction.
